8.heading: a snail:
refs: Shabbelool, in Chaldee tivlala, the snail, is probably so called from the Arabic balla, to wet, moisten, because of the glutinous slime emitted from its body, by which it appears to waste itself away in its own motion
and in the same manner the wicked prove their own destruction.
8.body:
